title: Paul McCartney live: Adelaide Oval, Adelaide | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Adelaide Oval in Adelaide, Australia, on 13 March 1993.

It was the eighth night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.
